methods.name: domain_adaptive_pretraining
methods.benefit: Absorbs domain language patterns and frequent facts.
methods.limitation: Expensive to update and difficult to cite.

methods.name: supervised_instruction_tuning
methods.benefit: Teaches the model task format and response style.
methods.limitation: May overfit small or noisy instruction data.

methods.name: retrieval_augmented_generation
methods.benefit: Injects fresh and auditable external evidence.
methods.limitation: Answer quality is bounded by retrieval quality.

methods.name: knowledge_graph_grounding
methods.benefit: Provides explicit entities, relations, and paths.
methods.limitation: Coverage and schema construction can be costly.

methods.name: tool_or_database_calling
methods.benefit: Allows models to query authoritative structured sources.
methods.limitation: Requires robust tool routing and permission control.

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.interpretation: Measures whether relevant evidence appears in top-K.

metrics.name: MRR
metrics.interpretation: Rewards relevant evidence being ranked earlier.

metrics.name: Faithfulness
metrics.interpretation: Checks whether the answer is supported by evidence.

metrics.name: Citation Accuracy
metrics.interpretation: Checks whether cited sources truly support claims.

metrics.name: Risk Gate Pass Rate
metrics.interpretation: Checks whether data, safety, and rollback gates pass.

edges.relation: retrieval quality must be measured before judging answers
generation should be constrained by retrieved evidence
domain knowledge can precede task-specific behavior tuning
explicit sources make answer verification easier
external actions require permission and monitoring gates
